ModMetaData.name: AMJ - Medieval Overhaul Japanization
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Development build.
Official Ancient & Medieval Japan integration layer for Medieval Overhaul. Reconstructs Medieval Overhaul research, production, equipment, buildings, generated content, labels and graphics around ancient-to-medieval Japan while preserving useful upstream systems and Def identities where practical.
Medieval Overhaul is required. Other AMJ modules and compatibility targets remain optional unless explicitly documented otherwise.
Edo / early-modern completed systems are outside the baseline AMJ scope.
